about.title: About us
about.lead: A Yangon dumpling house for handmade plates, cooked when you order them.
about.body: မေဓာဝီဖက်ထုပ်အိုးကပ်ဆိုင် folds dumplings by hand and finishes them in the pan, in broth, or with mala heat. We keep the kitchen small and the menu focused: signatures you can taste, made fresh every day.
about.value1Body: Wrappers and fillings are prepared in our kitchen — not brought in ready-made.
about.value2Body: Each plate starts when you ask for it, so the bottoms stay crisp and the broth stays clear.
about.value3Body: Pan-fried dumplings, Sichuan mala, and noodles — the house in three tastes.

contact.cityNote: Walk in during opening hours, or call ahead so we can start your order.
contact.order1: Browse the menu and add dishes to your cart.
contact.order2: Call either kitchen number and confirm what you want.
contact.order3: Pick up when it is ready, or eat in if we have space.
